items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I remember when I was quite young in Homestead that bands used to come through Homestead, The Lloyd Brothers which was a very popular band in those days and Cecil Scott's band.

ctx.x: But there weren't regular dance bands in the 1920s, I don't think.

Oh, yeah, there were quite a few dance bands. I remember when I was quite young in Homestead that bands used to come through Homestead, The Lloyd Brothers which was a very popular band in those days and Cecil Scott's band. All these bands played -- there were big bands and you had bands that played in the pits, especially in the theaters where they had the black productions and there was a field for musicians, quite a few. The only way I would know, I wouldn't know about Cliff's band and I wouldn't know about…
